svg.text: Stage 1.2: Prenatal Motor Babbling & 2D Cortical Homunculus Self-Organization
Spontaneous Spinal Twitches + Mechanical Limb Coupling + Mexican-Hat Lateral Inhibition Sort the Unwired Grid into a Body Map
Why This Solves the Genomic Bottleneck Without Manual Neuron Placement:
1. At t = 0 (left), all cortical tiles sample random ascending proprioceptive wires. Adjacent cortical columns represent unrelated body parts.
2. Spontaneous isolated spinal twitches vibrate single joints; mechanical inertia couples parent-child links in the same limb (e.g. Shoulder-Elbow-Wrist).
3. Cortical Mexican-Hat lateral competition + Hebbian/BTSP spine conservation locks correlated joints into contiguous 2D cortical zones (middle).
